title: gateway: stale comments claim Rust Content-Format 0 wire differs from C (false since 49e460a240)
description: Two comments in rust/lichen-gateway/src/resources.rs still describe the pre-49e460a240 serializer behavior: (1) win-arm handler comment ~:2139-2142 says 'the Rust serializer (gateway.rs) instead maps content_format 0 to a present zero-length option, so the wire is not byte-identical to C'; (2) test comment in conflict_response_echoes_own_recorded_envelope ~:3244-3246 says content_format 0 maps to a present zero-length option (0xc0) NOT an omitted option as C does. Commit 49e460a240 added encode_content_format_option() which OMITS the option when content_format == 0 for C byte-parity (lichen_coap_respond / coap_oscore.h '0 for none'), so both comments are now false and contradict the CoapResponse::content_format doc comment updated by that commit. Fix: rewrite both comments to state the wire is byte-identical (option omitted for 0). Comment-only change, no behavior.
close_reason: Rewrote both stale comments (resources.rs win-arm + conflict_response_echoes_own_recorded_envelope) to state encode_content_format_option omits the Content-Format option at 0, byte-identical to C. 270/270 gateway tests pass, cargo fmt clean on resources.rs, clippy unchanged (pre-existing warnings only). 3x codereview via kimi-k3 (correctness/security/edge-cases): all PASS, zero findings.
